decisions.thought: Incineroar leads for Intimidate, Fake Out, and Parting Shot to blunt the physical attackers like Annihilape and Kingambit. Gholdengo gives a strong special threat with Life Orb, and Garchomp adds fast physical pressure to finish off weakened targets.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
